text: Make a square book-swap poster. Black lettering only, no pictures. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall'. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
